LanguageData.Gun_SCAR-L_LB_RWP.description: The SCAR-L LB (Lightweight Battle Rifle) is a versatile assault rifle known for its reliability and precision. Featuring a long barrel for improved accuracy at extended ranges, it delivers a balanced rate of fire and moderate stopping power, making it ideal for mid-range engagements. Suitable for skilled marksmen, this weapon excels in both offensive and defensive roles.
